cards.name: Cloud, Midgar Mercenary
cards.oracle_text:
When Cloud enters, search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
As long as Cloud is equipped, if a triggered ability of Cloud or an Equipment attached to it triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.flavor_text: Identity is complicated. Swords are not.

cards.name: Oswald Fiddlebender
cards.oracle_text: Magical Tinkering — {W}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavor_text: Can't see this airship crashing in the near future. Sturdy as a rock.

cards.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
cards.oracle_text:
Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater.
If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.flavor_text: It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you.

cards.name: Recruiter of the Guard
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with toughness 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.flavor_text: Before a cause can have supporters, it has to have a voice.

cards.name: Spellseeker
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.flavor_text: Not content with mere answers, she hunts for the truth.

cards.name: Enduring Curiosity
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
When Enduring Curiosity dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. It's an enchantment. (It's not a creature.)
cards.flavor_text: How many lives until it learns its lesson?

cards.name: Preston, the Vanisher
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a 0/1 white Illusion.
{1}{W}, Sacrifice five Illusions: Exile target nonland permanent.
cards.flavor_text: Making a second one is easy. Convincing reality to keep both is harder.

cards.name: Prime Speaker Vannifar
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavor_text: All lives end. Some simply deserve less time.

cards.name: Urza, Lord High Artificer
cards.oracle_text:
When Urza enters, create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}.
{5}: Shuffle your library, then exile the top card. Until end of turn, you may play that card without paying its mana cost.
cards.flavor_text: When you've eliminated the possible, what remains?

cards.name: Mox Amber
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
cards.flavor_text: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

cards.name: Mox Opal
cards.oracle_text: Metalcraft — {T}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if you control three or more artifacts.
cards.flavor_text: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

cards.name: Skullclamp
cards.flavor_text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

cards.name: Helm of the Host
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token that's a copy of equipped creature, except the token isn't legendary. That token gains haste.
Equip {5}
cards.flavor_text: When both claim to be the original, survival settles the matter.

cards.name: Nyx Lotus
cards.oracle_text:
Nyx Lotus enters tapped.
{T}: Choose a color. Add an amount of mana of that color equal to your devotion to that color. (Your devotion to a color is the number of mana symbols of that color in the mana costs of permanents you control.)
cards.flavor_text: Are you prepared for your faith to be tested?

cards.name: Fierce Guardianship
cards.oracle_text:
If you control a commander, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost.
Counter target noncreature spell.
cards.flavor_text: No good commander stands alone.

cards.name: Gaea's Cradle
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {G} for each creature you control.
cards.flavor_text: Mother provides.

cards.name: Savannah
cards.oracle_text: ({T}: Add {G} or {W}.)

cards.name: Tropical Island
cards.oracle_text: ({T}: Add {G} or {U}.)

cards.name: Tundra
cards.oracle_text: ({T}: Add {W} or {U}.)

cards.name: Grim Monolith
cards.oracle_text:
This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
{T}: Add {C}{C}{C}.
{4}: Untap this artifact.
cards.flavor_text: Part prison, part home.

cards.name: Mana Vault
cards.oracle_text:
This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {4}. If you do, untap this artifact.
At the beginning of your draw step, if this artifact is tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.
{T}: Add {C}{C}{C}.
cards.flavor_text: Some doors are better left unopened.

cards.name: Mana Drain
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next main phase, add an amount of {C} equal to that spell's mana value.
cards.flavor_text: I suppose you've never heard of conservation of energy.

cards.name: Derevi, Empyrial Tactician
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When Derevi enters and whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may tap or untap target permanent.
{1}{G}{W}{U}: Put Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
cards.flavor_text: When she falls, another finds their place.

cards.name: Academy Rector
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, search your library for an enchantment card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.flavor_text: The final lesson is learned only after the teacher is gone.

cards.name: Phyrexian Altar
cards.oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature: Add one mana of any color.
cards.flavor_text: The price of a miracle is less than you think.

cards.name: Survival of the Fittest
cards.oracle_text: {G}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.flavor_text: There's always a bigger fish.
